rationale: Price is sitting at 87.5% of today's range, just below the session high of $22.34, with the last five 1-minute candles showing very low volume and tight, directionless chop around $22.10–$22.12 — no clear momentum impulse in either direction. The 9-EMA ($22.17) is essentially at current price, offering no meaningful separation to define a clean entry thesis, and the ATR of ~$0.07 on 5-minute bars is extremely narrow relative to the spread cost and slippage risk on a name that has already made its large move today. With 107 minutes to close and no structural setup forming, the risk/reward does not justify committing capital.
